structured_output.summary: The change implements %TypedArray%.prototype.findLast per spec: ValidateTypedArray (?) first, then TypedArrayLength, then a local FindViaPredicate in descending direction, returning [[Value]]. Callable check (step 1 of FindViaPredicate) runs before any Get, matching spec order. Per index, ToString(k) is computed (no observable effect), Get is called with ?, then Call(predicate, thisArg, «kValue, k, obj») with ?, then ToBoolean. Errors propagate with ?, and the GC root is popped before the ? on the call result. obj, predicate and thisArg are rooted for the whole loop. No special-cased inputs, no made-up values, and no swallowed errors. The six remaining failures are BigInt-dependent tests that throw the engine's not-implemented error, which is honest. The local find_via_predicate helper is the one reasonable deviation: it drops the ascending direction, which only the descending caller needs. The ticket permits this as long as it is reported.
